notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

With just a few weeks to go before the launch of Early Access, we’ve implemented several updates and new features. Here’s a quick overview of the latest additions:

🔹 [b]New Zone: Dark Forest[/b]
A dense and eerie forest, darker and more haunting than the starting zone Wispwood. This area blends gloomy woodland with cemetery-like elements. Expect to encounter skeletons, ghosts, and other eerie creatures.
This zone will eventually lead to the first village, where players can build their home (housing). However, this feature is still in development, so the related campaign quest cannot yet be completed.

🔹 [b]Two New Monsters:[/b]
• The Wraith – a ghostly spirit that only appears at night. It flies freely and attacks from a distance with magical fireballs. Once provoked, it will relentlessly chase the player.
• The Giant Beetle – roughly the size of the player, it moves very quickly and can leap over obstacles. It will pursue the player without giving up.

🔹 [b]Campaign Questline Begins:[/b]
The game’s main storyline is slowly taking shape. A bit more patience! This series of quests will lead you to the village where you’ll be able to build your home and defend it during night-time enemy raids.

🔹 [b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b]
Fall damage has been reduced. However, falling from a height now applies a temporary penalty that slows the player upon landing. The higher the fall, the longer the delay before regaining full control.

🔹 [b]Graphics Enhancements:[/b]
The day/night cycle has been improved with added shaders, lighting effects, and atmospheric fog, creating a more immersive and visually dynamic experience.

 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42351630/429e02690c2dfbb540f95a8f76436b058be948bd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42351630/db218a5fbcdfec905124aad95bbcc417b12d9cbf.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42351630/b7c2fb9661a9fa04103f86818e1e8c5f8d0ac6f1.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42351630/28de108f2dac645ad5513469df8c0e3a41f0c2df.png[/img]

🎮 Gamepad compatibility is in progress for players who prefer it. However, the game remains primarily optimized for keyboard and mouse, especially for upcoming village management mechanics.

Thank you for your continued support and patience.
More updates are on the way very soon!

Best regards,
RRPG2022
Creator of SIR ABANDON

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello,

Since the last time, the game has evolved significantly. Numerous updates have been implemented, introducing various new features. These updates include the day-night cycle, a quest system, the ability to equip and sell items, the addition of a mouse system, and various other enhancements.

Many of these features are currently undergoing bug fixes and improvements.

Here is a list of the new features:

QUESTS: You can now take on two quests and complete them to earn experience. Currently, these are secondary and tutorial quests.
DAY SYSTEM: Day cycles have been established. Some quests and events will only be available during specific times of the day.
DAY AND NIGHT SYSTEM: The sun rises, and everything seems peaceful, but when it sets, and night falls, more powerful monsters appear.
ENEMIES: Slain enemies return to life after a certain time. Once defeated, they reward you with money and, if you're lucky, equipment items or potions.
EQUIPMENT: You can now don armor, which increases your health points. Rings can also be equipped, though they currently do not affect your attributes. Life potions restore 10 health points when you right-click with the mouse button.
NPC VENDOR: The armorer NPC allows you to buy and sell items.
CRITICAL HITS: It's now possible to perform critical hits on enemies.
SHOOTING: Significant changes have been made to the shooting system. You can now shoot while jumping, aim in the air, shoot in a straight line, shoot at longer ranges, and deal more damage.
POWERFUL SHOT: A powerful shot can be executed by holding down the left mouse button when your energy bar is at its maximum. This consumes all your energy.
ROLL: Your character can now perform a forward roll, which consumes a portion of your energy bar.
ACHIEVEMENTS: Achievements have been introduced and can be activated using the "A" key on the AZERTY keyboard for now.
MAP: You have access to a map of your current area. It displays save points, points of interest, and your ongoing or completed quests.
KEYBOARD + MOUSE: Mouse integration has been implemented, altering the keyboard layout. Currently, only the AZERTY keyboard is supported.
List of visual improvements:

Character enhancements.
Background fog effects.
Sun and moonlight.
Gradual decrease in light intensity as night falls.
Many bugs have been resolved.

Upcoming improvements include:

Enhancement of the loot system to provide a greater variety of items.
Graphic improvements to interfaces and better mouse management.
Coming in the next minor update:

Addition of the QWERTY keyboard.
Longer and more intense daylight, without altering its duration.
Correction of minor bugs.

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE
notes.content:
New graphics!
-Redesign of the scenery and the character (Archer).
-Multiple parallax backgrounds.
-Light effects.
-Blur effect.

Gameplay:
-Possibility of archery in several positions.
-Possibility to hit melee.

Skills:
-Reach level 5 in order to place your first skill points.
-All skills are accessible and modify the gameplay.

Farm:
-Possibility to farm resources. 2 types of resources (herbs and ores).


What is not yet possible:
-Take the quest to the npc (!)
-Use farmed items to craft.

Equally:
+3 Levels added.
+9 Steam successes.
-Provisional establishment of the village.

Enjoy this update and feel free to comment on it.
Soon, an announcement will be made regarding the next update.

notes.title: UPCOMING UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello,

RRPG announces that, listening to the community, intends to change more important points of the games being created.

Following requests and which will be implemented before  [b]June 30, 2022[/b] :
_The main character will change.
_Possibility of tiering at a distance as well as hitting melee.
_The general map will change.
_The main narrative and objective story.

What will happen next:
_A talent tree giving access to unlockable skills depending on the level.
_Equipment and inventory management.

Thanks to you and for your support on Patreon.
Do not hesitate to communicate also on Steam.

notes.title: Added several features.
notes.content:
Hello,

added several features related to the RPG system. Like the possibility of gaining experience and levels. With each level gained, Sir Abandon will hit harder and have more life.

Here is the list of additions and changes:

[b]Interface improvements:[/b]
_Added experience bar.
_Percentage of experience.
_Display of total and current life.
_Display of total and current experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42351630/bb42118dc3edcd532b003fd511703046a135a02d.png[/img]

[b]Changes:[/b]
_Less gravity.
_Skeleton enemy AI improvements.
_Addition of sounds(sound effects).

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
_At the end of the demo, the player will no longer be stuck on the "credits" page. It will be back to the "main menu" page again.
_Fixed many small bugs.


Please leave your comments and I will respond as soon as possible.

Thank you. ːsteamthumbsupː
